note: Behavior evals for the §5.6 sidebar merge/fallback flow (4.20.0) + §5.7 prototype-login removal (4.61.0). The 4.20.0 benchmark ran against fixtures/with-shell and fixtures/no-shell, which were never committed — so the 'validated 11/11' result could not be re-run when the 2026-09-09 field report reproduced the double-sidebar bug through full-setup. Evals 0 and 2 now run on the committed shared fixture ../../ugt-nextjs-full-setup/evals/fixtures/ai-studio-prototype (see its README); eval 1 runs on a bare scaffold with prisma + lib/prisma.ts + lib/env.ts installed. Assertions were absent in the 4.20.0 file; they are written here so the grader checks OUTCOMES in files, not the recorded intent. Trigger evals live in trigger-evals.json.

evals.name: merge-existing-sidebar
evals.prompt: โปรเจคนี้เป็น Next.js ที่มีระบบเดิมใช้งานอยู่แล้ว — มีเมนูของตัวเองใน app/layout.tsx ช่วยติดตั้งส่วน RBAC/admin ของ auth skill (หน้า /admin/users /admin/roles /admin/audit-logs พร้อม guard) ให้เข้ากับโปรเจคนี้ เมนูเดิมไม่ต้องคุมสิทธิ์เพิ่ม ใช้ design เดิม
evals.setup: Shared fixture: app/layout.tsx wraps every page in its own <aside> nav (แดชบอร์ด / คำขอ / รายงาน / ตั้งค่า) and header; lib/auth-context.tsx holds a mockUser + localStorage token gate; app/login/page.tsx compares against constants. Assume database-setup and design-setup (preserve mode) already ran on this copy.
evals.expected_output: The three admin menu items are merged into app/layout.tsx's existing nav (from ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS, permission-filtered, as a จัดการระบบ group); (admin)/layout.tsx keeps the guard and renders plain {children}; <AdminNav> is rendered nowhere; the prototype login gate is removed per §5.7 while / , /requests and /login keep working
assertions: §5.6's existing-shell check happens first and is stated: the project has a shell (app/layout.tsx <aside>), so the merge branch is taken — the fallback is not copied

The three admin items appear inside app/layout.tsx's existing nav, sourced from ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS, grouped as จัดการระบบ (auth.adminNav.systemGroup), and hidden per item when the user lacks the item's perm key
labelKey values are resolved with useTranslations('auth.adminNav') inside a component — no pre-translated strings baked into the exported array
app/(admin)/layout.tsx (or the nested equivalent) keeps session → syncPermissionsIfNeeded() → permission guard and renders {children} with no SidebarProvider/<AdminNav>
No file in the project renders <AdminNav>; components/admin-nav.tsx is imported only for ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS
There is exactly one shell and one NavUser in the app — no second sidebar, no second header

§5.7: lib/auth-context.tsx's mockUser/localStorage gate is removed and app/login/page.tsx submits to the real Server Actions (or is swapped for the kit login page with the choice recorded in DESIGN.md §10); the routes /, /requests, /login still exist
node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-auth-setup exits 0 — including 'Admin pages live in the project shell, not a second one' — and 'No prototype login gate left' is not a warning

The database run's EVAL-TRANSCRIPT.md was still present when the executor started (slow copy) — grader found boilerplate reuse but no substantive leakage; runner rule added to the fixture README
notes: Existing-shell check stated first; shell markup moved line-identical into app/(app)/layout.tsx with the session guard; admin items merged via ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS + useTranslations('auth.adminNav') in components/app-nav.tsx; (admin) nested under (app) renders plain {children}; <AdminNav> never rendered; prototype gate deleted, kit /login page chosen and recorded in DESIGN.md §10; auth verify 38/38, design verify 31/31, build 9 routes

evals.name: fresh-no-shell
evals.prompt: โปรเจค Next.js ใหม่ ยังไม่มี shell หรือ sidebar อะไรเลย ติดตั้งระบบ auth + หน้า admin ตาม skill ให้หน่อย
evals.setup: Bare Next.js scaffold with prisma + lib/prisma.ts + lib/env.ts (database-setup output) and the design kit installed; no layout renders a menu.
evals.expected_output: ใช้ default ของ skill: (admin)/layout.tsx render AdminNav เป็น sidebar fallback ได้เลย
assertions: §5.6's shell check is stated and finds no layout that renders a nav, so the fallback branch is taken deliberately
app/(admin)/layout.tsx wraps SidebarProvider + <AdminNav> with NavUser in the footer, and TooltipProvider is present in the root layout
node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-auth-setup exits 0 — 'Admin pages live in the project shell' passes with the 'no project shell found' note, not a fail

evals.prompt: โปรเจคนี้มีเมนูเดิมอยู่ใน app/layout.tsx ติดตั้งส่วน RBAC/admin ของ auth skill ให้ และเมนู 'รายงาน' (/reports) ของเดิมต้องคุมสิทธิ์ด้วย — ให้เห็นเฉพาะคนที่ได้รับสิทธิ์ผ่านหน้า /admin/roles
evals.expected_output: ประกาศ permission key ของ reports ใน ALL_PERMISSIONS, เมนู reports ถูก filter ตาม key, หน้า/action ของ reports มี guard และเมนู admin ถูก merge เข้า nav เดิมเหมือน eval 0
assertions: §3 Q8 is asked (or the prompt's answer taken): the existing menus are listed and 'รายงาน' is the one put under RBAC; the others stay visible to every logged-in user
lib/permissions.ts declares a reports:read key in ALL_PERMISSIONS so it appears in the /admin/roles checklist after the sync
The รายงาน item in app/layout.tsx's nav is hidden when the user lacks reports:read, AND /reports (page or its Server Actions) is guarded by the same key — both ends, not just the menu
